architecture.title: The system behind this site.
architecture.intro: A small full-stack application where the data layer, infrastructure and admin panel work as one system.
architecture.browserDetail: React app built with Vite and served by Nginx
architecture.apolloDetail: Typed operations, caching and a localized UI
architecture.graphqlDetail: Code-first schema generated from NestJS decorators
architecture.nestDetail: Feature modules, guards and application services
architecture.prismaDetail: Explicit data access for portfolio content
architecture.storageDetail: Storage layer for files in an S3-compatible store
architecture.runtimeIntro: Each layer has a clear role: the browser renders the interface, GraphQL handles the request, Prisma accesses the database and object storage keeps files separate.
architecture.contractTitle: Type safety from API to UI
architecture.contractIntro: The GraphQL schema generates frontend types, so API models are not duplicated by hand.
